text: ヤマブキ　シティも　いちじは　ひとが　にげて　へっちゃった　けど　にぎやかな　まちに　もどるわ！

structure.jp: ヤマブキ　シティも
へっちゃった　けど
にぎやかな　まちに　もどるわ！
structure.en: it will go back to being a lively town!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう says something happened completely, often to your regret; ちゃった is the short spoken form. へっちゃった = 'ended up going down'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: にげて　へっちゃった
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, here with a feeling of 'and so'. にげて　へっちゃった = 'fled, and so the number dropped'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.span: へっちゃった　けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with 'but'. へっちゃった　けど = 'the number dropped, but'.
